rationale: unweighted unsmoothed CE; highest observed validation macroAP among A--E, not a claim of final balanced superiority
head: masked mean/max h -> LayerNorm512 -> Linear128 -> SiLU -> Linear1 -> sigmoid
head_rng: CPU constructor RNG preserved; no forward head dropout
clipping: backbone/head separately; otherwise detached control could rescale backbone gradients
optimizer: AdamW; head in separate group with same LR, weight decay and warmup
validation: metric-specific best and Pareto; no final balanced winner claimed; AP best.pt compatibility alias
interpretation: head MAE alone cannot demonstrate improvement of residue prediction
features_and_split: identical frozen union inputs and SI30 assignment to completed D run
